entry.title: The Backroom: Dynamic pricing and the anxious consumer
entry.summary: With the holidays approaching, consumers are zeroed in on price now more than ever — and Walmart is taking the heat.

entry.title: FTC orders Target, Walmart to provide details in personalized pricing inquiry
entry.summary: The agency sent the order to nine companies to examine how personal data is being used, even through loyalty programs, to potentially alter price tags.

entry.title: DoorDash to buy Instacart for $17B
entry.summary: The deal marks the consolidation of two major players in the retail delivery industry.

entry.title: Heydude wants to sell more in North America, but is unlikely to open new stores
entry.summary: The brand returned to growth in Q3 compared to its weak results last year, thanks largely to wholesale revenue from retail partners.

entry.title: Most consumers aren’t using AI for product discovery, yet
entry.summary: Retailers should consider the quality of their metadata to prepare for a predicted upswing in AI usage, new research finds.

entry.title: Fanatics revamps outfit curation tool with OpenAI
entry.summary: A new version of the retailer’s Shop the Look tool generated 10% higher engagement in a pilot.

entry.title: Victoria’s Secret’s Pink leans into beauty with ‘Mini Bar’ collection
entry.summary: The Pink Mini Bar features collaborations with Vacation, Mario Badescu and Fazit and will have a dedicated section featuring the products in stores.

entry.title: The Weekly Closeout: Roots CEO exits, the FTC zeroes in on price
entry.summary: The chief executive stepped down following the outdoor retailer’s go-private deal. Meanwhile, the agency has been focused on how retailers set prices.

entry.title: Amazon CEO says retail business is being slept on
entry.summary: Andy Jassy spoke in depth about AWS and AI during a Q3 earnings call, but reiterated the importance of the company’s store progress.

entry.title: Louis Vuitton exec to lead Bergdorf Goodman
entry.summary: It’s full circle for Lanessa Elrod, who had previous stints at all three Exemplar Luxury Group banners — Bergdorf, Saks Fifth Avenue and Neiman Marcus.
